claims.statement: ClinVar versions submissions, exposes conflicts, supports programmatic access, and enables reevaluation.
ACMG published professional points to consider for genomic-result reevaluation and reanalysis.

contrary_evidence: ClinVar is free and laboratories may already monitor their own cases.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: counselors, LIMS vendors, and inherited-disease clinics.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: 250 clinics at 40000 PLN annually yield 10 million PLN ARR and founder equity above 5 million PLN in six to eight years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: 12-16 hours weekly with clinical and privacy advisers.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated hypothesis: 70% after security and support.
economics.payback: Unvalidated hypothesis: annual contracts within nine months.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: 3000-12000 PLN monthly plus 20-80 PLN per monitored case.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: growing historical cohorts create switching costs.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Adjudicated alerts deepen workflow rules and switching costs
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Change-detection queue and consent-aware audit registry
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The clinic pays to monitor cases and document reviewed recontact
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A public assertion changes or conflicts with an earlier interpretation

founder_fit: Genetics interest and data skills align while clinical authority stays with professionals.
risks: Missed or noisy alerts can harm patients.
Intended use may trigger IVD obligations.

structure.control_point: A longitudinal graph of cases, variant versions, adjudications, consent, and recontact outcomes
structure.critical_dependency: Secure laboratory integration and a validated non-diagnostic boundary

thesis: A clinician-controlled registry maps historical genetics cases to evolving variant assertions and routes changes for review without autonomous medical decisions.
title: Variant Recall Registry
uncertainties: Recontact duties, budgets, and false-alert tolerance are unresolved.
